```python
PARAMS = {
    "gm1":  (20.0, 10.0, 24.0),     # gm/Id of front CS nfet (weak/moderate inversion)
    "L1":   (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),       # front device L
    "Ics":  (9e-6, 4e-6, 16e-6),    # CS stage current
    "Isf":  (7e-6, 3e-6, 14e-6),    # source-follower current
    "gmsf": (15.0, 8.0, 22.0),      # follower gm/Id
    "Rf":   (4.5e5, 4.0e5, 7.0e5),  # feedback resistor
    "Cf":   (1e-15, 0.1e-15, 20e-15),  # feedback cap (peaking control)
    "Lp":   (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # PMOS load L
    "Ip":   (2e-6, 1e-6, 4e-6),     # PMOS bias-branch current
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    cpd = spec.get("cpd", 5e-13)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    kT = 1.380649e-23 * 300.15
    Rf, Cf = p["Rf"], p["Cf"]
    Ics, Isf, Ip = p["Ics"], p["Isf"], p["Ip"]

    # --- front CS device: its Vgs sets the iin DC level, which equals vout_dc (Rf carries no DC)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gm1"], p["L1"], Ics, vds=1.1)
    vin_dc = m1.vgs
    vout_dc = vin_dc
    # --- source follower (bulk = vss, so vsb = vout)
    m3 = lut.size("n", p["gmsf"], 0.3, Isf, vds=max(VDD - vout_dc - m1.vgs, 0.2), vsb=vout_dc)
    va_dc = vout_dc + m3.vgs
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gm1"], p["L1"], Ics, vds=va_dc)
    # --- PMOS load and its diode reference (same L and gm/Id)
    gmid_p = 10.0
    m2 = lut.size("p", gmid_p, p["Lp"], Ics, vds=max(VDD - va_dc, 0.2))
    mb3 = lut.size("p", gmid_p, p["Lp"], Ip, vds=0.8)
    mb3 = lut.size("p", gmid_p, p["Lp"], Ip, vds=mb3.vgs)
    # --- nfet mirror bank from ibias
    gmid_b, Lb = 12.0, 1.0
    mb1 = lut.size("n", gmid_b, Lb, iref, vds=0.5)
    mb1 = lut.size("n", gmid_b, Lb, iref, vds=mb1.vgs)
    mb2 = lut.size("n", gmid_b, Lb, Ip, vds=VDD - mb3.vgs)
    m4 = lut.size("n", gmid_b, Lb, Isf, vds=vout_dc)

    n = Netlist("iin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB1", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb1)
    n.dev("MB2", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb2)
    n.dev("MB3", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mb3)
    n.dev("M1", "va", "iin", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "va", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", m2)
    n.dev("M3", "vdd", "va", "vout", "vss", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m4)
    n.R("RF", "vout", "iin", Rf)
    n.C("CF", "vout", "iin", Cf)

    # --- small-signal nodal model (nodes x=iin, a=va, o=vout)
    cgd1 = m1.cgd
    cgs1 = max(m1.cgg - m1.cgd, 0.0)
    cgs3 = max(m3.cgg - m3.cgd, 0.0)
    Ca = m1.cdd + m2.cdd + m3.cgd
    Co = cl + m4.cdd
    Cx = cpd + cgs1
    gf = 1.0 / Rf
    ga = m1.gds + m2.gds
    gm1, gm3, gmb3 = m1.gm, m3.gm, m3.gmbs
    go = m3.gds + m4.gds

    def zt(f):
        s = 2j * PI * f
        yf = gf + s * Cf
        Y = np.array([
            [s * Cx + s * cgd1 + yf, -s * cgd1, -yf],
            [gm1 - s * cgd1, s * cgd1 + ga + s * Ca + s * cgs3, -s * cgs3],
            [-yf, -gm3 - s * cgs3, yf + s * Co + go + gm3 + gmb3 + s * cgs3],
        ], dtype=complex)
        v = np.linalg.solve(Y, np.array([1.0, 0.0, 0.0], dtype=complex))
        return v[2]

    z0 = abs(zt(1e3))
    fs = np.logspace(4, 10, 1200)
    zs = np.array([abs(zt(f)) for f in fs])
    below = np.where(zs < z0 / math.sqrt(2))[0]
    f3 = float(fs[below[0]]) if len(below) else 1e10

    # --- equivalent noise current at 1 MHz
    w = 2 * PI * 1e6
    en2 = 4 * kT * (1.0 / gm1 + m2.gm / gm1 ** 2) * 1.3   # thermal; 1.3 covers flicker/excess
    ctot = Cx + cgd1 + Cf
    in2 = 4 * kT / Rf + en2 * ((w * ctot) ** 2 + gf ** 2)
    in_noise = math.sqrt(in2)

    power = VDD * (iref + Ip + Ics + Isf)

    return n, {
        "zt_dbohm": db(z0),
        "f3db": f3,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": vout_dc,
        "in_noise_1m": in_noise,
    }
```
